inspiration: Copy the bonus, not the base: one spell reads a unit's current attack and health, subtracts the unit's base values, and applies only the leftover bonus to the target. If both leftovers are zero it does nothing (spellDoubleAttributeBuffs.coffee:15-21). Recreate as a modifier-stack rule: a spell copies a unit's accumulated buffs, not its base stats. Good for the parity row 3 and stat-modifier ideas.

One atlas per unit with frame keys that name the animation and the index (units/boss_andromeda.plist:7). Recreate as one sheet per creature with frame names like idle, attack and hit plus an index, so an animation player can pick frames by name.

Rarity shine as an overlay: a card rarity is shown with three gradient overlay files and one atlas, not a new card art (app/resources/prismatic/). Recreate as a rare-item shine: one gradient overlay per rarity colour, drawn over the item icon.

Hex-framed portraits with an @2x pair: boss portraits are cut in a hex frame and shipped at two resolutions (app/resources/boss_battles/). Recreate as a boss portrait in a frame that stays readable at 375 wide, with a high-resolution twin for retina screens.

Two-line announcer per faction: each faction has a first and second announcer line (app/resources/sfx/sfx_announcer_*). Recreate as a two-stage fight call (opening and first hit) per boss, with a distinct voice per boss.

One music bed per battle map: battle tracks are named per map and faction (app/resources/music/music_battlemap*). Recreate as a music bed per zone with a stinger for boss rooms. Maps to the sound-music topic: layering and ambience beds per biome.

Locale split by feature: 34 English locale files, one per feature (cards, battle, rift, codex, rank, tutorial), and each card has a name key and a description key (app/localization/locales/en/). Recreate with one locale file per feature and the same name-plus-description pair for items and abilities.

briefs.label: Bonus-copy spell
briefs.why: A spell that rewards building up a unit rather than ignoring it. Reads at 375 wide as a small icon with a visible stat change.
briefs.keep: Copy the difference between a unit's current and base stats, and apply only the difference. Do nothing when the difference is zero.
briefs.change: Copy a different stat set (for example the speed bonus into a shield), and show the copied amount as a tick mark, not a number. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Hex-framed warden portrait
briefs.why: A boss portrait in a hex frame reads at a small size and fits a card and a phone screen. The two-size set keeps it sharp on high-density screens.
briefs.keep: Hex-shaped frame. Two sizes, the high one named with a @2x suffix.
briefs.change: A round-cut frame with an ember ring, a different palette, and the portrait cropped to the head rather than the full figure. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Rarity shine overlay
briefs.why: A rare item that shines without changing its art. Cheap to draw: one gradient overlay per colour.
briefs.keep: A gradient overlay per rarity colour, drawn over the icon. A small atlas for the shine.
briefs.change: Our shine moves across the item on a timer and sits on a dark frame, not a bright card. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Two-line boss call
briefs.why: A boss that speaks twice, once on entry and once on its first hit, gives the fight two readable beats with sound alone.
briefs.keep: Two lines per boss, the first at entry, the second at the first big hit.
briefs.change: One voice per boss in a different register, not a faction announcer. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
